name: The Vine Mother

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Black Row, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's tree blight and vine blight: branches with reach, a grasping vine that drags and holds, scaled to CR 8 with legendary actions and a spray of black wine.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Vine Mother fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Branch attacks and a Grasping Vine.
actions.text: The Vine Mother makes two Branch attacks and uses Grasping Vine.

actions.name: Branch
actions.summary: A sweep of black vine-wood with 15 ft reach.

actions.name: Grasping Vine
actions.summary: DC 16 Str save by a Large or smaller creature within 20 ft: dragged 15 ft closer and held by a vine (escape DC 15), crushed 2d6+6 at the start of each of her turns.
actions.text: One Large or smaller creature the Vine Mother can sense within 20 feet makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw. Failure: the target is pulled up to 15 feet toward her and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of her turns. She can hold two creatures this way.

actions.name: Black Wine
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: a 30-ft cone of fermenting black sap; DC 15 Con save, 4d8 Poison and Poisoned until the end of her next turn, half damage on a success.
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the Vine Mother's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

options.name: Creeping Roots
options.summary: Moves up to her Speed through the soil, without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

summary: A cutting of the Gulthias tree, planted under the Martikovs' Seventh Row by the druids and grown into the row itself: a heaving mass of black vine-wood twice the height of a house. Her branches reach, her vines drag you in and squeeze, and she spits fermenting black wine.
